findings_addressed.oracle: Windows registry HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services subkeys (read independently via winreg.EnumKey); bridge_names must be a subset of reg_names, and known_services={eventlog,plugplay} must intersect bridge_names.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/bridges/process.py _parse_service_entries(), change `services.append({...})` to `services.append({"name": "", ...})` (empty name) - bridge_names would not intersect known_services, failing the assert.
findings_addressed.notes: Gate now resets the shared advapi32 SCM ctypes prototypes via _reset_scm_ctypes_prototypes() before driving enumerate_services so the gate is deterministically RED regardless of test order. enumerate_services returns [] standalone because it never configures OpenSCManagerW.restype = SC_HANDLE, truncating the 64-bit SCM handle. Stays RED until P-TG-005 is fixed in src.

findings_addressed.oracle: Independent cross-check: active_names must equal the set of names whose state=='running' in the full (active=False) list; every entry in active_services must carry state=='running'.
findings_addressed.documented_mutation: In src/intellicrack/bridges/process.py enumerate_services(), change `state_filter = SERVICE_ACTIVE if active else SERVICE_STATE_ALL` to always use `SERVICE_STATE_ALL` - active_services would then include stopped services with state!='running', failing `assert svc.get('state') == 'running'`.
findings_addressed.notes: Same _reset_scm_ctypes_prototypes() determinism guard as G0087. Stays RED until P-TG-005 is fixed in src.

prod_defects.summary: OpenThread uses THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION but WaitForSingleObject requires SYNCHRONIZE, so the wait always returns WAIT_FAILED; also WaitForSingleObject.restype is not DWORD so WAIT_FAILED (0xFFFFFFFF) is read as -1 and mislabelled 'other_-1'.
prod_defects.empirical_proof: OpenThread(THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION)+WaitForSingleObject returns 0xFFFFFFFF (WAIT_FAILED); OpenThread(THREAD_QUERY_INFORMATION|SYNCHRONIZE) returns 0x102 (WAIT_TIMEOUT) for a running thread.

prod_defects.summary: enumerate_services never configures OpenSCManagerW.restype = SC_HANDLE so the 64-bit SCM handle is truncated to 32 bits; EnumServicesStatusExW then fails with ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE and the method returns []. Only works by accident if list_services (which configures the shared prototype) ran first in the same process.
prod_defects.empirical_proof: Standalone enumerate_services() returns 0; after list_services() (which sets OpenSCManagerW.restype=SC_HANDLE) a subsequent enumerate_services() returns 333. Probe shows unconfigured OpenSCManagerW returns a truncated handle 431280464 with EnumServicesStatusExW GetLastError=6 (ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE); configured handle 2830814730112 yields GetLastError=234 (ERROR_MORE_DATA), bytes_needed=56435.

notes: The two enumerate_services gates are production-defect gates (P-TG-005), made deterministically RED via _reset_scm_ctypes_prototypes(). A prior fixer also added two time_thread_wait gates that are not in the findings but legitimately surface P-TG-004 (missing SYNCHRONIZE); kept as falsifiable RED gates. All 4 gates stay RED until src is fixed (see PRODUCTION-DEFECTS.md). Sandbox: 14 passed, 1 env-skip (GetProcessMitigationPolicy), 4 expected-RED prod-defect gates.
